Tilda Setup Instructions
fields.options:
Tilda Webhook Setup:

  1. Go to Site Settings → Forms → Webhook.
  2. In the "Webhook URL" field, paste the URL from the field above.
  3. Important: Enable the option Send data as application/json. Our handler expects this format.
  4. Enable the option Send Cookies if you want to automatically receive UTM tags (provided that the target Frappe doctype has fields like utm_source, utm_medium, etc.).
  5. Save the webhook settings in Tilda.

For more details, see the Tilda Webhook documentation.
